::: {.lead}
New England Patriots finished 2025 at 14&ndash;3. The model grades them as a contender: top-quartile passing offence with a defence that at least holds up. The profile that actually wins in January.
:::

## What the four phases look like

::: {.sec-note}
EPA **per play** in each of the four phases. Blue is creating points, red is costing them. Defence is sign-flipped so longer blue always means better. All four bars share one league-wide scale (max 0.306 EPA/play), so they are comparable to each other *and* to every other team page. Season totals are deliberately not used here &mdash; mixing totals and per-play rates on one axis would make the offence bars look four times longer than they are.
:::

## Identity

This team classifies as **Contender** &mdash; *Top-quartile passing offence with a defence that at least holds up. The profile that actually wins in January.*

Underneath, the offence reads as **"Good Offense Despite Run Game"**: the label describes how the offence distributes its production between the run and the pass, not how good it is.

| Dimension | Grade |
|---|---|
| Offence tier | **Elite** |
| Defence tier | **Elite** |
| Pass defence rank | **#6** |
| Rush defence rank | **#7** |
| Wins above / below model | **+1.2** |

## Personnel

**Quarterback.** **D.Maye** closed the season at **0.227 EPA per dropback** and **6.4% CPOE** over his rolling five-game window (through week 22).

**Running back.** **T.Henderson** led the backfield with **207 carries** at **-0.025 EPA per rush** (4.7 YPC, 38.6% success). Blocking versus creation: **3.0** yards before contact, **2.0** after. Style: *Contact creator*.

## 2026 outlook

The multi-year prior model projects **8.5 wins** for 2026, with a 90% interval of **1.9 to 15.1**. Fragility flag: **Neutral**.
